text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*, I'm really not cut out for this...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I played a game called Werewolf with everyone in class earlier.
It's a game where you have to guess who the Werewolf is.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "I guess I'm just really bad at lying or something... No matter how many times I try, I always end up losing..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In the end, they asked me, 'You're the werewolf, right?'
and I ended up admitting it...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna lose the game, but I can't lie either!
What am I supposed to do?!
Katsuragi Ace was left agonizing over how her own personality kept getting in the way of winning games.
